scope: Official Shopify Impulse:Impulse preset listing View demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility tree. Home, 36-product collection, The Ames Trouser PDP and empty cart inspected. No shopping controls, screenshot, measured viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Impulse:Impulse listing View demo opened impulse-theme-fashion.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Home presents category-linked fashion imagery, curated product shelves, promo tiles, journal content and newsletter offer; 36-product collection exposes a Filter entry, multi-choice sort and Quick View affordances.
claims.risk: No filter, sort or Quick View behavior was tested; promo and merchant content are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Use editorial and promotional modules to support category discovery while keeping filters, sort and product cards coherent.

claims.observed: The Ames Trouser page shows product copy, fit descriptors, SIZE CHART, in-stock copy, Add to Cart and product information accordions. Empty cart provides Continue shopping, recently viewed and generic Popular picks.
claims.risk: Product fit/material/certification/stock claims and cart recommendations are unverified; generic Example product cards appear placeholder-like.
claims.vsn_guard: Validate catalog-linked product details and recommendation content; give an empty cart a clear route back to products.
